description: Approved RFC/deprecation exceptions for the OpenAPI breaking-change gate. Entries must reference an approved Contract Change RFC or deprecation record before CI may allow a breaking OpenAPI contract change.

exceptions.approvedBy: bmsull560 (repo owner) via issue #1256 and the curated deprecation register; removal targets 2026-07-01 and 2026-08-01 passed before removal on 2026-08-10
exceptions.reason: Removal of overdue frontend-compat aliases (/v1/auth/register, /v1/tenant/settings) from layer4-agents.json per V1-PROVISION-001. Canonical replacements (/v1/tenants/register, /v1/tenants/current/settings) are unchanged. Frontend migration to canonical paths completed before the register's removal targets.

exceptions.approvedBy: bmsull560 (repo owner) via PR #1354 and ADR-043 / ADR-044
exceptions.reason: Hardened Clerk authentication endpoints (/v1/auth/authorization-snapshot, /v1/auth/clerk/tenant) in API Gateway: removed legacy request bodies on GET operations and aligned security scheme to Bearer JWT token verification per ADR-043 / ADR-044.

exceptions.approvedBy: bmsull560 (repo owner) via PR #1415 and Layer 3 Graph Alias Deprecation Policy (docs/contracts/layer3-graph-alias-deprecation-policy.md)
exceptions.deprecationRecord: docs/contracts/layer3-graph-alias-deprecation-policy.md (v2.5 deprecation window closure: removal of deprecated aliases label, type, confidence, relationship_type from layer3-knowledge.json)
exceptions.reason: Closure of v2.5 deprecation window for Layer 3 graph response field aliases (GraphNode.label -> name, GraphNode.type -> entity_type, GraphNode.confidence -> confidence_score, GraphEdge.relationship_type -> type) in layer3-knowledge.json per docs/contracts/layer3-graph-alias-deprecation-policy.md.

exceptions.approvedBy: RFC #1500 (add git metric completeness metadata to L4 AuditOrchestrator) via PR #1531
exceptions.reason: RFC #1500 adds two additive, optional fields to the L4 AuditOrchestrator Scorecard contract: git_metric_completeness (dict of GitMetricCompleteness) and git_warnings (list of GitWarning). Typing GitWarning with its structured per-field shape (code, metric, status, message, bytes_read and optional max_bytes/max_lines) introduces required_fields_added on the git_warnings items schema. Both fields are newly introduced by this RFC; the tightened schema is the RFC's intended per-field shape and carries no raw git output or contributor emails.

exceptions.approvedBy: R5 critical fix (Layer 3 <-> Layer 4 HTTP circular dependency) via PR #1557; green-main baseline restored first (PR #1553)
exceptions.deprecationRecord: docs/compliance/control-matrix.md (GDPR Art. 20 DSAR Export/Portability row; Layer 3 export proxy /v1/documents/export removed, business case exports flow directly from frontend to Layer 4)
exceptions.reason: Removal of the dead Layer 3 -> Layer 4 export proxy edge (/v1/documents/export) from layer3-knowledge.json to break the L3<->L4 HTTP circular dependency for independent deploy/versioning. The canonical L4 -> L3 /v1/knowledge direction is preserved. No compatibility proxy or model was introduced; the export business case flows directly from the frontend to Layer 4.

exceptions.approvedBy: PR #1570 (gateway security declaration alignment for fabric-4l-api.json)
exceptions.reason: Declared HTTPBearer security requirements on 16 API Gateway operations (assumptions/score, auth/api-keys, benchmarks, cfo-narratives/generate, evidence/extract-value-signals, jobs/{job_id}, realization/compare, usage, usage/quotas, value-drivers/map, value-models/generate, value-models/qa, value-models/validate) that were previously served without declared security. The spec now matches the API Gateway's enforced auth middleware; no runtime behavior change.

exceptions.approvedBy: PR #1570 (L2.5 Signal Refinery OpenAPI regeneration for layer2-5-signal-refinery.json)
exceptions.reason: Regenerated contracts/openapi/layer2-5-signal-refinery.json to match the live L2.5 Signal Refinery API surface (commit 6d316a1cc): removed stale /health path, updated root security declaration, aligned error responses (422 error/detail shape, removed 400/401/404/409 stubs that the service does not emit), and dropped response fields the service does not serialize. The regenerated spec is the source of truth for the actual Routes; consumers of the previous hand-copied spec absorb the corrected contract.

exceptions.approvedBy: bmsull560 (repo owner) via PR #1596 (billing de-duplication; Layer 4 canonical, Layer 7 removed)
exceptions.reason: Billing de-duplication (Brooks-Lint R3): removed the duplicated production billing implementation from services/layer7-billing and made Layer 4 the single canonical owner. contracts/openapi/layer7-billing.json was regenerated from the L4 billing surface (6 paths removed, 47 response fields removed, 7 required fields added) so the file remains a valid L4-subset contract for downstream consumers while the standalone L7 service is deleted. The 60 breaking changes are the intended contract reshape that removes the Layer 7 duplicate.
